extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - The add-on no longer copies its fonts into the skin you are using. They travel in a small companion add-on instead, which Kodi installs alongside this one, and any copies an earlier version left behind are cleared away. Nothing looks different; there is simply less of us in your skin. - An error message no longer appears while the add-on updates itself. A new version arriving while the old one was still closing down could put a Kodi error notice on screen for a moment. Nothing was affected by it.

extension.news: - One press of Up brings you back from a title's episodes or cast to the buttons at the top of its page. It used to take two. - A long episode title or cast name scrolls while it is highlighted, rather than stopping at three dots. The rows on Home have always done this; the episodes and the cast on a title's page now do it too. - Removing something from Continue watching leaves the highlight where it was, and the next title moves into the space. It used to jump back to the first title on the row.

extension.news: - Less work while a film plays. The player was asking Kodi the same question five times a second in a way that turned out to be expensive on a set-top box; it now asks a cheaper one. Nothing looks different -- it simply leaves more of the box free for the picture. - The Rewatch button on a title's page shows a replay arrow. It had been showing a toggle switch.

extension.summary: Fonts for the tofa for Kodi add-on
extension.description:
The typefaces the tofa for Kodi add-on draws its own screens in: Inter Tight, Roboto Mono and the Lucide icon set.
Installed automatically as a dependency of tofa for Kodi. It provides font files and nothing else: no screens, no settings, and nothing runs. It is not useful on its own.
Kodi looks inside enabled font resources for any font file it cannot find in the active skin, so tofa's screens can name these files without a copy of them being placed in the skin.
